notes.title: Limberjack’s Pink October
notes.content:
In honor and recognition of all female loggers and arborists around the world, Husqvarna Limberjack will turn pink for the month of October.  We hope that this small initiative can serve as a reminder to raise awareness and funds that will help find a cure for breast cancer. 

The update also includes several bug fixes to improve game play. Have fun, and respect the saw!

-The Limberjack Team
www.limberjackvr.com

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Limberjack
notes.content:
Limberjack is Now Available on Steam!

Known to chainsaw-wielding loggers around the world as ‘limbing’, the art of stripping felled trees of their branches is exciting, but very dangerous. Welcome to Limberjack! Grab your Husqvarna chainsaw, and pursue your dream of becoming the undisputed greatest limber alive.

notes.title: The world of Limberjack is now live
notes.content:
It´s time to unleash your inner Limberjack and start your journey to become the worlds best VR limber.

If you experience performance issues, hold down the ctrl button during launch to display the quality settings screen. There´s three settings to choose from: Low (GTX 970), Medium (GTX 980) and High (GTX 1080)

Have fun and limb until you drop!

- The Limberjack Team
www.limberjackvr.com
